$comment: p15-oracle-070: the misc family's 28 mutations (credential, frontend_projection, history, keybindings, notification, pairing_request, palette_usage, settings, window_record); gen_daemon_ops.py reads this file, run it after an edit. driver_daemon.py connects without a client-hello, so its connection derives origin agent (request_origin.rs ConnectionOrigin::derive): the six operations that need the verified app (Gate A2 USER_ONLY_OPERATIONS and the credential owner gate, server/origin_gate.rs) and pairing accept refuse it before validation, so their error cases assert that origin.forbidden and their success cases carry a gap until the driver proves an install key (p15-oracle-237) or opens a pairing (p15-oracle-238). history.restore needs a page visit, which only history.visit.record (user only) makes. The other error cases reach the handler where the catalog check let them: a key stroke, a host name, a missing record, a stale revision, an unknown backup, an agent's reset_all.
